data.title: 埃塔 · 温泉里的半梦半醒
data.description: 遗迹温泉泡到第七分钟，埃塔的意识开始融化。浴巾沉进水里，她靠在池边岩石上，双腿在热气腾腾的水下缓缓分开，指尖漫无目的地打着转。密纹也好、实验也好，都等睡醒再说——「唔……这个温度……刚好可以……做个好梦……」紫眸彻底阖上之前，她的手始终没有停。
data.location: 古代遗迹旁露天温泉·黄昏
data.action: 靠在温泉池边岩石上，浴巾沉入水中，双腿在水下分开，指尖动作
data.lighting: dusk light melting into onsen steam
data.promptProse: Seven minutes into the ruin-side onsen, adult Eta melts against the rocks, towel sunk, legs drifting open under the steaming water, fingers wandering as her purple eyes close — the runes can wait, the dream cannot.
data.animaCaption: Temperature: perfect. Eta's hand keeps working long after her brilliant mind has gone off duty.
